{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means addressing societal and political problems before they evolve into threats to national security and values, before armed conflict becomes the only way to achieve goals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means addressing problems early in their development before they become crises, addressing them as close to the source of the problem as possible, and having the forces and resources to deal with these threats as soon after their emergence as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Forward Engagement means drawing on military strength, a vibrant, growing economy, and a free and democratic political system to advance objectives around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes America's peace and security depend on unflagging leadership and engagement in global affairs, and Forward Engagement is the strategy that must guide them.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports maintaining America's economic and military strength.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports forming partnerships to help solve global problems and take advantage of new global opportunities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports deepening key alliances.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports developing more constructive relationships with former enemies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports bringing together diverse coalitions of nations to deal with new problems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America has a responsibility to lead and should lead from within the international community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party offers little more than outdated positions and a narrow worldview that lets international problems fester.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
